title: Petra and the Oath
author: Edmund Pemberton
blurb: Bram Coldharbour, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
